summary: This note describes Roxas Airport, which serves the Roxas City area, capital of Capiz province in the Philippines. It states the airport's classification as a Class 1 principal airport and identifies the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines as the body responsible for it. The note also gives the airport's names in Hiligaynon and Tagalog.
one_line: Roxas Airport is a Class 1 principal airport serving Roxas City, capital of Capiz province, Philippines.
key_facts: Roxas Airport serves the general area of Roxas City in the Philippines.
Roxas City is the capital of the province of Capiz.
The Hiligaynon name of Roxas Airport is "Hulugpaan sang Roxas".
The Tagalog name of Roxas Airport is "Paliparan ng Roxas".
Roxas Airport is classified as a Class 1 principal airport.
The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines classifies Roxas Airport as a Class 1 principal airport.
The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines is a body of the Department of Transportation.
The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines is responsible for the operations of Roxas Airport.
The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines is responsible for all airports in the Philippines except the major international airports.
